row.notes: Pit lane: car idx < 27 entering the pit lane. Only acts when the car's pit status ([self+0x68+idx*16]+4) is 1. Online: posts pit message (vtable 0x145843a50, 0x260000000a) when the lobby slot matches. Calls 0x1434cf650(self, idx, status+8). Then decides: pit-stop record state 99, or self+0x300 (forced box), or (car not in state 2 and no stop requested 0x142f294d0 and no request flag) -> either posts 'drive-through' msg 0x145845958 (when [self+0x298]+0x38) or releases the garage slot (0x142e96f30 on [self+0x2e0]) and sets pit status 2 (Game_Pitlane_SetVehicleStatus) plus, when forced, bus msg 0x145624020 payload idx|6<<32; otherwise sets pit status 15. Callers 0x142a4216d, 0x1434d0249 and tail jumps 0x1434cf9af, 0x1434d1bba, 0x1434d1ec0. (used by vmknolle race-start)
